protocol.mimic: protocol v2: development set = old validation + old test splits (62 stays, 26 patients; prompt v1 -> v2 developed here, LLM-free tuning uses it); held-out test = 31 stays from 9 patients drawn from the old training patients only (never an LLM query before), evaluated once with the frozen configuration; knowledge base and ML training data for the test run = remaining 114 stays / 21 patients
protocol.ktas: MAIN evaluation with the frozen configuration (prompt v2), never used for development: full test split (191 cases); S4 knowledge base = all MIMIC-IV-ED stays (222) + KTAS training split only (886), KTAS validation/test never in the knowledge base; S3 on the same 191 cases; secondary S4 with KB = MIMIC-IV-ED only on the same 191 cases (117-case stratified sample first, then the other 74)
